Name: Dachshund (Dog Replacer)
Author: DarkKassanova
Description:
This mod replaces your dog with a weenie dog! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PxWGwF3.png[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/XPuEN3y.png[/img]

There are two separate files. One with the hot dog buns, and one without!
[b][u]
To Install:
[/u][/b]1. Backup your dog.xnb file in Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download whichever version you'd prefer and extract the new dog.xnb
3. Replace your old dog.xnb with the new one
